nodes.label: ADR-001: Use TypeScript strict + ESM
nodes.rationale: TypeScript 6 with strict mode, ES2022 target, ESNext modules, and Bundler moduleResolution. Bans any/as any/as unknown. Chosen for compile-time type safety on security-sensitive code handling untrusted PR content.

nodes.label: ADR-002: Bundle with @vercel/ncc
nodes.rationale: Use @vercel/ncc to compile TypeScript into a single dist/index.js. Check dist/ into git. Pre-commit hook auto-rebuilds. Chosen over node_modules check-in (too large) and runtime install (network dependency).

nodes.label: ADR-003: Prompt injection defense
nodes.rationale: Multi-layered defense: label PR content as UNTRUSTED in prompt, block pull_request_target, skip forks, load rules from base SHA. Prevents LLM manipulation via attacker-controlled PR diffs, titles, and descriptions.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Incremental diffing
nodes.rationale: On synchronize events, diff only the new commits (payload.before to head.sha) via GitHub compare API. Saves LLM tokens, avoids duplicate comments, and scopes review to actual changes.

nodes.label: ADR-005: Three-tier review submission fallback
nodes.rationale: 3-tier fallback: full review with suggestions, strip suggestions on 422, summary-only on 422. Uses withFallback utility for graceful degradation. Partial results preferred over no results.

nodes.label: ADR-006: Structured logging with secret scrubbing
nodes.rationale: Emit structured JSON prefixed with ::structured:: via core.info. Scrub secrets (GITHUB_TOKEN, JULES_API_KEY) and untrusted fields. No external logging library needed.
nodes.norm_label: adr-006: structured logging with secret scrubbing

nodes.label: ADR-007: Multi-agent architecture
nodes.rationale: 4 specialized agent roles with linear handoff: codebase-explorer (read-only), spec-planner (planning), code-builder (execution), code-reviewer (audit). Separates concerns and prevents scope creep in AI-assisted development.

nodes.label: ADR-008: Vitest with 90% coverage thresholds
nodes.rationale: Vitest 4 with @vitest/coverage-v8 for fast execution and native TypeScript/ESM support. 90% thresholds on lines, functions, branches, statements enforced at commit time and in CI.

nodes.label: ADR-009: Jules retry resilience
nodes.rationale: Single retry on timeout only (not auth/parse errors). Create fresh Jules session with full timeout budget. Handles transient outages without doubling latency in happy path.

nodes.label: ADR-010: Split utils into domain modules
nodes.rationale: Split grab-bag utils.ts into resilience.ts, validation.ts, filtering.ts, errors.ts. Each module named after domain concept with narrow interface (1-2 exports). Improves locality, testability, and AI-navigability.

nodes.label: Retry-on-Timeout Pattern
nodes.rationale: Transient Jules outages cause permanent review loss; a single retry doubles success chance during degraded periods without configuration changes

nodes.label: Agentic Diff Mode
nodes.rationale: Full PR diff embedded in prompt hits 80 KB truncation limit and provides no structural awareness; agentic mode lets Jules run git diff directly for full repo context

nodes.label: Fallback State Machine
nodes.rationale: Agentic mode must degrade gracefully; session-creation failure and timeout trigger prompt-mode fallback so exactly one review is always posted

nodes.label: Session Archiving
nodes.rationale: The SDK has no cancel method; archive only removes from list view; failed archive is cosmetic and should never fail the review

nodes.label: changedFiles Verification
nodes.rationale: LLM may hallucinate changedFiles; verification is informational only—any mismatch is logged and surfaced but never treated as failure

nodes.label: Prompt Injection Defense
nodes.rationale: PR title, description, diff, rules file, and ignored_paths are labeled UNTRUSTED to prevent reviewed code from manipulating the LLM verdict

nodes.label: Read-Only Prohibition
nodes.rationale: Agentic mode gives Jules repo access; a SECURITY section at prompt top prohibits modifying, creating, or deleting files to limit blast radius

nodes.label: SHA-Based Diff Instruction
nodes.rationale: SHAs are used in the diff instruction string for prompt-injection defense; baseBranch SDK parameter expects a branch name, not a SHA

nodes.label: Ignored Paths Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Action-side filterDiff remains as defence-in-depth; agentic prompt also provides ignored_paths with instructions to merge with .gitignore

nodes.label: Large-PR Nudge
nodes.rationale: When >50 files changed, a soft nudge instructs Jules to prioritize high-impact reviews; no hard truncation applies in agentic mode (80 KB limit dropped)

nodes.label: Suggested Changes Feature
nodes.rationale: Opt-in code suggestions in PR review comments with guardrails for security, formatting, and graceful submission degradation

nodes.label: Suggestion Output Schema
nodes.rationale: ReviewComment type gains optional suggestion and startLine fields; startLine defines the first line of a multi-line replacement

nodes.label: Suggestion Pre-Submission Validation
nodes.rationale: Invalid startLine (startLine > line) is discarded; triple-backtick sequences in suggestion are escaped to prevent broken markdown rendering

nodes.label: Suggestion Prompt Security Guardrail
nodes.rationale: suggestion must contain only valid source code replacing flagged lines; must not contain shell commands, URLs, or markup; only emitted at High/Medium confidence

nodes.label: Mode Branching in index.ts
nodes.rationale: Both pipelines share the same pre-amble and post-amble; branching at the diff-fetch stage keeps them DRY without duplicating 200+ lines of shared orchestration

nodes.label: 3-Tier Graceful Submission Degradation
nodes.rationale: Tier 1: submit with suggestions; Tier 2 on 422: strip suggestions and retry; Tier 3 on second 422: summary-only fallback
